readings.title: 53. Abasing himself before God
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: رَبِّ أَفْحَمَتْنِيْ ذُنُوبِي، وَانْقَطَعَتْ مَقَالَتِي،
records.transliteration: rabbi afhamatnii dhunuubii, wa'inqaṭaʿat maqaalatii
records.english_text: My Lord, my sins have silenced me, and my words have been cut off.

records.arabic_text: فَلاَ حُجَّةَ لِي، فَأَنَا الأَسِيـرُ بِبَلِيَّتِي، الْمُـرْتَهَنُ بِعَمَلِي، الْمُتَرَدِّدُ فِي خَطِيئَتِي، الْمُتَحَيِّرُ عَنْ قَصْدِي، الْمُنْقَطَعُ بِي،
records.transliteration: fala ḥujjata li, fa-ana al-'asīru bi-balīyatī al-murtahanu bi'amali, al-mutaraddidu fi khatiyyati al-mutahayyiru ʿan qasdī, al-munqaṭaʿu bī
records.english_text: I have no argument, for I am the prisoner of my own affliction, the hostage to my works, the frequenter of my own offense, the confused in my intended way, the thwarted.

records.arabic_text: قَدْ أَوْقَفْتُ نَفْسِي مَوْقِفَ الأَذِلاَّءِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ، مَوْقِفَ الأَشْقِيآءِ الْمُتَجَرِّينَ عَلَيْكَ، الْمُسْتَخِفِّينَ بِوَعْدِكَ.
records.transliteration: qad awqaf tu nafsī mawqif al-'adhilā'i al-mudhnibīn mauqif al-ashqiyaa al-mutajarreena ʿalayka, al-mustakhiffina bi-waʿdika
records.english_text: I have brought myself to a halt in the halting place of the abased sinners, the halting place of the wretched and insolent, those who think lightly of Thy promise.

records.arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ! أَيَّ جُرْأَة اجْتَرَأْتُ عَلَيْكَ؟
records.transliteration: subḥānaka! ʾayya jurʾatan ijtarātū ʿalayk?
records.english_text: Glory be to Thee! What insolence I have insolently shown toward Thee!

records.arabic_text: وَأَيَّ تَغْرِير غَرَّرْتُ بِنَفْسِي
records.transliteration: wa-ayy taghreer gharrartu bi nafsi
records.english_text: What delusion with which I have deluded myself!

records.arabic_text: مَوْلاَيَ إرْحَمْ كَبْوَتِيْ لِحُرِّ وَجْهِي، وَزَلَّةَ قَدَمِي، وَعُدْ بِحِلْمِكَ عَلَى جَهْلِي، وَبِإحْسَانِكَ عَلَى إسَآءَتِي، فَأَنَا الْمُقِرُّ بِذَنْبِي، الْمُعْتَرِفُ بِخَطِيئَتِي، وَهَذِهِ يَدِيْ وَنَاصِيَتِي،
records.transliteration: mawlāya irḥam kabwātī li-ḥurri wajhī wa-zallata qadami, wa'ud bi-hilmika 'ala jahli wa bi-iḥsānika ʿalā ʾisāʾatī, fa-anā al-muqirru bi-dhanbī al-muʿtarifu bi-khatīʾatī, wa-hādhīhi yadī wa-nāṣiyatī
records.english_text: My Master, have mercy on my falling flat on my face the slipping of my foot, grant me my ignorance through Thy clemency, and my evildoing through Thy beneficence, for I admit my sin and I confess my offense: Here are my hand and my forelock!

records.arabic_text: أَسْتَكِينُ بِالْقَـوْدِ مِنْ نَفْسِي .
records.transliteration: astakīnul bil-qawdi min nafsī
records.english_text: I am resigned to retaliation against my soul!

records.arabic_text: إرْحَمْ شَيْبَتِي، وَنَفَادَ أَيَّامِي، وَاقْتِرَابَ أَجَلِي، وَضَعْفِي، وَمَسْكَنَتِي، وَقِلَّةَ حِيلَتِي.
records.transliteration: irḥam shaybatī, wa nafad 'ayyāmī, waqtirab ajali, wadhaʿfi wa maskanati, wa qillata heelati
records.english_text: Have mercy on my white hair, the depletion of my days, the nearing of my term, my frailty, my misery, and the paucity of my stratagems!

records.arabic_text: مَوْلاَيَ وَارْحَمْنِي إذَا انْقَطَعَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا أَثَرِي، وَامَّحى مِنَ الْمَخْلُوقِينَ ذِكْرِي، وَكُنْتُ فِي الْمَنْسِيِّينَ، كَمَنْ قَدْ نُسِيَ.
records.transliteration: mawlāya warḥamnī iżā inqaṭaʿa mina al-dunyā atharī waammahā mina al-makhlooqeen dhikree wa kuntu fil-mansiyīn, kaman qad nusiya
records.english_text: My Master, and have mercy upon me when my trace is cut off from this world, my mention is effaced among the creatures, and I join the forgotten, like the forgotten ones!

records.arabic_text: مَوْلاَيَ وَارْحَمْنِي عِنْدَ تَغَيُّرِ صُورَتِي وَحَالِي إذَا بَلِيَ جِسْمِي، وَتَفَرَّقَتْ أَعْضَائِي، وَتَقَطَّعَتْ أَوْصَالِيْ، يا غَفْلَتِي عَمَّا يُرَادُ بِيَ.
records.transliteration: mawlāya warḥamnī ʿinda taghayyuri ṣūratī waḥālī 'iḏā balīya jismī, wa tafarraqat 'aẓā'ī wa taqattaʿat awsālī, yā ghaflatī ʿammā yurādu bī
records.english_text: My Master, and have mercy upon me at the change of my form and state when my body decays, my limbs are scattered, and my joints are dismembered! O my heedlessness toward what was wanted from me!

records.arabic_text: مَوْلاَيَ وَارْحَمْنِي فِي حَشْرِي وَنَشْرِي، وَاجْعَل فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَومِ مَعَ أَوْلِيَآئِكَ مَوْقِفِي، وَفِي أَحِبَّائِكَ مَصْدَرِي، وَفِي جِوَارِكَ مَسْكَنِي يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
records.transliteration: mawlāy warḥamnī fī hašrī wa-našrī wa-jʿal fī dhālika al-yawm maʿa awliyāʾika mawqifī wa fī aḥibbā'ika maṣdari wa fī jiwarika maskanī yā rabb al-ʿālamīn
records.english_text: My Master, have mercy upon me at my mustering and uprising and on that day, appoint my standing place with Thy friends, my place of emergence with Thy beloveds, and my dwelling in Thy neighbourhood! O Lord of the worlds!

readings.title: 54. Removal of Worries
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: يَا فَارِجَ الْهَمِّ وَكَاشِفَ الغَمِّ،
records.transliteration: yā fārija al-hammi wa kāshifa al-ghammi
records.english_text: O Reliever of worry! O Remover of grief!

records.arabic_text: يَا رَحْمنَ الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ وَرَحِيمَهُمَا،
records.transliteration: yā raḥmān al-dunyā wa-l-ākhirah wa raḥīmahumā
records.english_text: O Merciful in this world and the next and Compassionate in both!

records.arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد، وَافْرُجْ هَمِّيَ، وَاكْشِفْ غَمِّيَ،
records.transliteration: ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa āli muḥammad wa afruj hammi, wa akshif ghammi
records.english_text: Bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, relieve my worry, and remove my grief!

records.arabic_text: يَا وَاحِدُ يَا أَحَدُ، يَا صَمَدُ،
records.transliteration: yā wāḥidu yā ʾaḥadu, yā ṣamadu
records.english_text: O One, O Unique, O Eternal Refuge!

records.arabic_text: يَامَنْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ،
records.transliteration: yamam lam yalid walam yūlad walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahadun
records.english_text: O He Who has not begotten, nor has been begotten, and equal to Him is not any one!

records.arabic_text: اعْصِمْنِي وَطَهِّرْنِي، وَاْذهِبْ بِبَلِيَّتِي.
records.transliteration: ʿiṣimnī waṭahhirnī, waʾdhib bi-balīyatī
records.english_text: Preserve me, purify me, and take away my affliction!

records.arabic_text: [وَاقْرَأْ آيَةَ الْكُرسِيّ وَالْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ وَقُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ وَقُلْ:] أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ، وَضَعُفَتْ قُوَّتُهُ، وَكَثُرَتْ ذُنُوبُهُ، سُؤَالَ مَنْ لاَ يَجِدُ لِفَاقَتِهِ مُغِيْثاً،
records.transliteration: wa qra'a ayyat al-kursiyy wal-mu'awwadhatayn, waqul huwa allahu ahad, waqul: allāhumma innī as'aluka suʾāla mani ishtaddat fāqatuhu waḍaʿufat quwwatuhu, wakathurat dhunubuhu suʾāla man lā yajidu li-fāqatihi mughīthan
records.english_text: HERE YOU SHOULD RECITE THE THRONE VERSE (2:255), THE TWO SURAS OF TAKING REFUGE (113-114), AND UNITY (112). THEN SAY: O God, I ask Thee with the asking of him whose neediness is intense, whose strength is frail, whose sins are many, the asking of one who finds no helper in his neediness,

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ لِضَعْفِهِ مُقَوِّياً، وَلاَ لِذَنْبِهِ غَافِراً غَيْرَكَ، يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإكْرَامِ.
records.transliteration: walā liḍaʿfihī muqawwiyāً walā liẓanbihi g̲h̲āfirān g̲hayraka yā dhāl-jalāli wal-ikrāmِ
records.english_text: no strengthener in his frailty, no forgiver of his sin other than Thee, O Possessor of majesty and munificence!

records.arabic_text: أَسْأَلُكَ عَمَلاً تُحِبُّ بِهِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهِ، وَيَقِيناً تَنْفَعُ بِهِ مَنِ اسْتَيْقَنَ بِهِ حَقَّ الْيَقِينِ فِيْ نَفَاذِ أَمْرِكَ.
records.transliteration: as'aluka 'amalan tuhibbu bihi man 'amila bihi wa yaqīnan tanfaʿu bihi mani istayqana bihi ḥaqq al-yaqīni fī nafāḍi ḥamrik
records.english_text: I ask of Thee a work through which Thou wilt love him who works it and a certainty by which Thou wilt profit him who is certain with the truth of certainty concerning the execution of Thy command!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد، وَاقْبِضَ عَلَى الصِّدْقِ نَفْسِي، وَاقْطَعْ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا حَاجَتِي، وَاجْعَلْ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ رَغْبَتِي،
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa āli muḥammad waqbida ʿalaa al-ṣidqi nafsī waqṭaʿ mina al-dunya ḥājatī wa'jal fi ma 'indaka raghbati
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, take my soul while it is firm in sincerity, cut off my need for this world, make my desire for what is with Thee

records.arabic_text: شَوْقاً إلَى لِقَائِكَ، وَهَبْ لِي صِدْقَ التَّوَكُّلِ عَلَيْكَ .
records.transliteration: shawqan ilā liqāʾika wa hab li ṣidqa al-tawakkul ʿalayk
records.english_text: become a yearning to meet Thee, and give me true confidence in Thee!

records.arabic_text: أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ كِتَاب قَدْ خَلاَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كِتَاب قَدْ خَلاَ
records.transliteration: as'aluka min khayri kitabin qad khalā, wa a'ūdhu bika min sharri kitabin qad khala
records.english_text: I ask of Thee the good of the writ that has been made and I seek refuge with Thee from the evil of the writ that has been made.

records.arabic_text: أَسْأَلُكَ خَوْفَ الْعَابِدِينَ لَكَ، وَعِبَادَةَ الْخَاشِعِينَ لَكَ، وَيَقِيْنَ الْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ عَلَيْكَ، وَتَوَكُّلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْكَ.
records.transliteration: as'aluka khawfa al-'abideena laka waʿibādat al-khāshiʿīna laka wa yaqīn al-mutawakkilīna ʿalayk wa tawakkul al-mu'mineen alayka
records.english_text: I ask of Thee the fear of The worshipers, the worship of those humbly fearful of Thee, the certainty of those who have confidence in Thee, and the confidence of those who have faith in Thee.

records.arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ رَغْبَتِي فِي مَسْأَلَتِي مِثْلَ رَغْبَةِ أَوْلِيَآئِكَ فِي مَسَائِلِهِمْ، وَرَهْبَتِيْ مِثْلَ رَهْبَةِ أَوْلِيَآئِكَ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma ijʿal raghbatī fī mas'alatī mithla raghbati awliyai-ka fi masa-ili-him wa rahbatī mithla rahbati awliyā'ika.
records.english_text: O God, make my desire in my asking like the desire of Thy friends in their asking, and my fear like the fear of Thy friends!

records.arabic_text: وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي فِي مَرْضَاتِكَ، عَمَلاً لاَ أَتْرُكُ مَعَهُ شَيْئاً مِنْ دِيْنِكَ مَخَافَةَ أَحْد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ.
records.transliteration: wa astaʿmilnī fī marḍātika ʿamalan lā ʾa'truk maʿahu shayʾan min dīnika makhāfat aḥad min khalqika
records.english_text: Employ me in Thy good pleasure through works in which I will not leave aside anything of Thy religion fearing any of Thy creatures!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ هَذِهِ حَاجَتِي، فَأَعْظِمْ فِيهَا رَغْبَتِي، وَأَظْهِرْ فِيهَا عُذْرِي، وَلَقِّنِي فِيهَا حُجَّتِي وَعَافِ فِيْهَا جَسَدِيْ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma hādhīhi ḥājatī, fa'a'ẓim fīhā raghbatī wa'aẓhir fīhā ʿuẓrī, wa-laqqinī fīhā ḥujjatī wa-ʿāfi fīhā jasadī
records.english_text: God, this is my need, so make my desire for it great, within it make manifest my excuse, through it instil me with my argument, and by means of it make well my body!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَصْبَحَ لَهُ ثِقَةٌ أَوْ رَجَآءٌ غَيْرُكَ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma man aṣbaha lahu thiqaẗun aw rajāʾun ghayruka
records.english_text: O God, some rise in the morning having trust or hope in other than Thee.

records.arabic_text: فَقَدْ أَصْبَحْتُ وَأَنْتَ ثِقَتِي وَرَجَآئِي فِي الأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا، فَاقْضِ لِيْ بِخَيْرِهَا عَاقِبَةً، وَنَجِّنِيْ مِنْ مُضِلاَّتِ الْفِتَنِ،
records.transliteration: faqad asbahtu wa anta thiqati warajāʾī fil-umūr kullihā faqdhi li bi khayriha 'aqibatan wa najjini min mudhillatil fitan
records.english_text: I rise in the morning, and Thou art my trust and my hope in all affairs, so decree for me those which are best in outcome and deliver me from misguiding trials,

records.arabic_text: بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
records.transliteration: bi-raḥmatika yā arḥama r-raḥimīn
records.english_text: O Most Merciful of the merciful!

records.arabic_text: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّد رُسُولِ اللهِ المُصْطَفَى، وَعَلَى آلِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ.
records.transliteration: wa ṣalla allāhu ʿalā sayyidinā muḥammad rasūli allāhi al-muṣṭafā wa ʿalā ālihi aṭ-ṭāhirīn
records.english_text: And God bless our chief, Muhammad the Messenger of God, the chosen, and his Household, the pure!
